S.FORM: == kakaliman == Kalitang "花生" Kalitang u cacay nu amilika a sinbun mutulin a mangga , misulitay sa ci cal-se.su-ce Charles M. Schulz). " ·舒茲(Charles M. Schulz). "Kalitang" u misamangaay macakat i naemekan nu pinaay a wayway a mangga , namakay 1950 a mihcaan 10 abulad 2 ademiad malingatu patahekal . Katukuh 2000 a mihcaan 2 abulad 13 ademiad ya misulitay hayni kapatay , pulung mutulin 17,897 ku cudad . 到2000年2月13 17,897幅. ya mangga makayni nu se-nu-pi a wacu ca-li sa-li nay-le-se lu-si siy-le-te pay-ti ma-si hulan-ke-li a papinaay a micudaday nu adidi'ay ku han , pakaynien nu nikaudip nu wawa kusapisulit tina aadihan , miadih tu madayumay macalilaway nu kitakit . (Schroeder),佩蒂 ,瑪西(Marcie), . misulitay ci calse.suce nitekaan nida a patadas misulit tu tatengaay nu sayku atu nu udip nipitanam misaadidi' tu maminay a wayway nu tademaw . u sulit ilabu idaw ku sakanawlan nu maudipay a sasakamun , muucul tu balucu' nu tademaw "idaw ku wayway nu mulatlatay" atu i mataay nu wawa nuni kaudip tu cayay kaedem . namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan:
